categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Primarius Technologies Co., Ltd. focuses on providing comprehensive EDA (Electronic Design Automation) solutions for integrated circuit design and manufacturing. Its main business segments include manufacturing EDA tools, design EDA tools, semiconductor device characteristic testing systems, and technical development solutions. The company also offers software licensing, hardware sales, and integrated technical development services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced core technologies such as Design-Technology Co-Optimization (DTCO), high-precision device modeling, circuit simulation, and automated PDK (Process Design Kit) verification. It develops high-performance parallel SPICE simulators, automated layout generation tools, and semiconductor parameter testing instruments. Production of hardware products involves assembly of standardized modules integrated with proprietary software, with critical components designed in-house and manufactured by suppliers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primarius serves leading global semiconductor foundries, IDM companies, memory manufacturers, and integrated circuit design firms. Its products are widely used in data processing, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, IoT, industrial applications, and computing peripherals. The company’s customer base includes top-tier clients such as TSMC, Samsung, UMC, GlobalFoundries, and domestic Chinese semiconductor enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with headquarters in Shanghai, China, and subsidiaries in the United States, South Korea, Belgium, Singapore, and other regions. It has expanded its presence in key domestic markets including Chengdu and Chongqing, and actively participates in international industry events across China, Taiwan, Korea, the US, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Primarius operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on EDA software development and semiconductor device testing equipment. It supports semiconductor design and manufacturing processes by providing critical design tools and testing systems, enabling chip design verification and process optimization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in EDA core algorithms, toolchain technology, and integrated full-process solutions centered on DTCO. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on advanced process nodes (7nm, 5nm, 3nm), AI integration, cloud computing, and expanding product lines to cover analog, digital, and memory chip design. It also emphasizes ecosystem building through industry collaboration and strategic acquisitions.
categories.revenue_model: Primarius generates revenue mainly through software licensing (fixed-term and perpetual licenses), sales of semiconductor device testing hardware, and provision of technical development solutions. Software licensing revenue is recognized over the license period, while hardware sales revenue is recognized upon delivery and acceptance. Technical services revenue is recognized based on contract terms and progress.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global EDA giants such as Synopsys, Cadence, and Siemens EDA. While these competitors dominate the global market with extensive product portfolios and scale, Primarius holds a leading position in China as the first publicly listed domestic EDA company. It has established international competitiveness in device modeling and circuit simulation, with growing market share and recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Primarius achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 419 million, a 27.42% increase year-over-year. Despite net losses due to increased R&D and stock-based compensation expenses, the company continues to grow its revenue and customer base. It employs 588 staff with 423 in R&D, and maintains a high R&D investment ratio of nearly 69% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth and innovation profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Primarius differentiates itself through its integrated full-process EDA solutions that tightly couple design and manufacturing optimization (DTCO). Its combination of advanced device modeling, high-precision circuit simulation, and semiconductor testing hardware creates a data-driven ecosystem that enhances chip yield, performance, power, and area metrics. The company’s strong domestic market presence, global customer validation, and continuous innovation underpin its unique value proposition.
